title: Read the Bison build sequence
description: You can follow how the grammar becomes a compiled parser. The final command supplies two arithmetic expressions as input.

steps.description: Bison reads tiny.y. The -d option requests a header, and -v requests a parser report.
gcc compiles the generated tiny.tab.c into the tiny executable.
printf sends two newline-terminated expressions through a pipe to tiny. The values shown later on the page belong to those inputs.
